8.22.1.5.3. iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.PiSPECConfigurator.store_geoinst_rule¶

PiSPECConfigurator.store_geoinst_rule(from_type, geo_type, doc)¶

Create amd store a GeoInstRule in the geoinst_rules list.

Parameters:
  • from_type (str) – The type of the original object(s), if such a type exists. E.g. the name of the object-type in the layout editor of Prover iLock.
  • geo_type (str) – The subtype of the geography object(s) of the rule.
  • doc (str) – Extra documentation for the created rule.
Return type:

none
